messages:
jordan-customer: Hi team, our users on Safari are seeing SSE streams from our app cut out after ~90s of activity. Other browsers fine. Happens when routed through our CDN. Partial events (last event truncated) then no reconnect. Repro steps attached.

maria-support: Sorry for the trouble — can you paste the minimal repro and any request/response headers? Is this behind cloud CDN/proxy?

jordan-customer: Yes CloudCDN in front. Quick repro: open page, EventSource to https://api.example.com/streams/live, stream tokens rotate every 10m. In Safari 16.4+ we see a few partial messages then connection stops and no onerror/onopen fire. Using eventsource-polyfill makes it slightly better but still stalls.

kevin-eng: Thanks. Two quick asks: 1) can you curl with -v -N to the SSE URL through the CDN and paste headers? 2) do you see any 304 responses from the edge? Safari + CDN + 304 is a known area of weirdness.

jordan-customer: Curl output (through CDN):
```
> GET /streams/live HTTP/1.1
> Host: api.example.com
> Accept: text/event-stream
< HTTP/1.1 200 OK
< content-type: text/event-stream; charset=utf-8
< transfer-encoding: chunked
< cache-control: public, max-age=60
< vary: Accept-Encoding
< content-encoding: gzip
```
Then after ~90s the edge returns `HTTP/1.1 304 Not Modified` for the same URL when the origin is polled and the browser stops receiving chunks.

tara-frontend: That `content-encoding: gzip` + `304` is suspicious. Safari sometimes treats a 304 with no body as end-of-stream, and if the CDN is serving a cached gzipped blob it can yield partial frames. EventSource requires streaming chunked responses with no content-length and no intermediate 304s.

chris-sre: Agree. CDN should not cache SSE responses. We should ensure SSE route has `Cache-Control: no-cache, no-transform` and `Vary: Origin` or `Vary: Accept-Encoding` removed for streaming endpoints. Also disable gzip/brotli on that path.

maria-support: Quick mitigation: can you try bypassing CDN for the SSE path (e.g., origin-direct or a rewrite)? If that fixes, we'll make an edge rule to bypass caching.

jordan-customer: Bypassing CDN = immediate fix. Streams stable again in Safari.

kevin-eng: Root cause summary: CloudCDN was returning cached 200 with gzip; when origin validated it returned 304 and Safari interpreted the validation as connection end. Because SSE relies on continuous chunks, the browser didn't attempt a reconnect loop (Safari quirk). The polyfill can't fully recover when the underlying TCP stream was closed abruptly with 304 semantics.

kevin-eng: Recommended permanent fixes (we rolled a test patch to edge):
- Ensure SSE endpoints return `Cache-Control: no-cache, no-store, private` (or `no-transform`) and `Connection: keep-alive` + `Transfer-Encoding: chunked`.
- Remove `Content-Encoding` on SSE responses (disable compression).
- Add `Vary: Origin` and `Access-Control-Allow-Credentials: true` + `Access-Control-Allow-Origin: <origin>` for credentialed EventSource calls.
- Edge rule: bypass cache for `^/streams/` and preserve `text/event-stream` content-type.

maria-support: @deploy-bot rolling out edge config to disable caching for /streams/ now.

deploy-bot: edge-config: disable-cache-for-path(/streams/*) v2 -> in progress (canary 5% -> 100% over 10m). :rocket:

chris-sre: Also note: some CDNs will insert `Content-Length: 0` on 304s; ensure validation responses don't change headers. Best to respond 200 with an open chunked stream rather than rely on cache validators for long-lived streams.

tara-frontend: Frontend defensive change: using `new EventSource(url, { withCredentials: true })` and handle `onerror` to attempt reconnect with exponential backoff. But that only helps if the socket fully closes with an error event — Safari sometimes doesn't fire that. So server-side fix is primary.

jordan-customer: Confirmed — after bypassing CDN then after deploy-bot completes, Safari sessions stable for 24h and partial events gone. Thanks everyone. :tada:

maria-support: Glad it's resolved. We'll follow up with a KB article: "SSE & CDNs: do not cache text/event-stream; disable compression; set no-transform" and link to recommended nginx/edge snippets.

kevin-eng: Snippet for nginx/edge to include in KB: 
```
location /streams/ {
  proxy_pass http://origin;
  proxy_set_header Connection "";
  proxy_set_header Accept "text/event-stream";
  proxy_set_header Cache-Control "no-cache, no-store, no-transform, private";
  proxy_buffering off;
  gzip off;
}
```

maria-support: I'll close this thread once KB is live. Thanks all.

jordan-customer: Closing from our side too. Appreciate the quick turnaround.
